## Why visit

A particularly rewarding example of the everyday northern pub interior: tiled passage, drinking lobby, front vault and rear lounge. The quality here lies in the survival of the arrangement and fittings rather than in theatrical scale. It is an easy addition to a route between Victoria and Swan Street, and the focused beer range invites attention to regional bitter. Go for the room and the social pub life as well as the pint; this is a different experience from the specialist beer bars nearby.

## Beer

Current CAMRA listing gives Joseph Holt Bitter and Ossett White Rat as regular cask beers.

## Plan the visit

Entertainment and sport can change the atmosphere; visit earlier if the room itself is the priority. Front entrance has steps; CAMRA describes a level rear entrance but no accessible toilet.

**Getting there:** Opposite Shudehill transport interchange; easy walk from Manchester Victoria.
